summary: Selectiebedrijf Kooi is a Dutch seed potato company based in Aerdenhout, Noord-Holland. It sells seed potatoes and supplies ware potatoes of its own protected varieties to growers, merchants and wholesalers. It breeds its own varieties and tests new ones on trial fields in the Netherlands and abroad.
products: Seed potatoes of its own protected varieties
